description: Patch schema for local Z-Image Turbo image-to-image generation through ComfyUI core nodes.

unmapped_ui_parameters.negative_prompt: The official Z-Image Turbo Comfy template uses ConditioningZeroOut for the negative conditioning path instead of a negative text prompt.
unmapped_ui_parameters.frames: The image-plugin frame control is preserved by the surrounding UI but this workflow emits one PNG per generate call.
unmapped_ui_parameters.strength: Preserved as zimage_denoise = 1.0 - ModelInputs.strength to match the previous plugin's img2img strength call.

output.contract: Return one readable PNG image matching the mapped requested dimensions.
